title: A Crowdsourced Study of ChatBot Influence in Value-Driven Decision Making Scenarios
reasoning: The paper focuses on how 'moral framing' (e.g., pacifism vs. fiscal conservatism) and value-driven cues in LLM interactions influence human reasoning and decision-making. It uses a 'Value Codebook' (Table 5) to evaluate participant responses across ethical and moral dimensions such as Equity/Pacifism and Accountability.
